name: Tidal Observatory — surface and detail kit
prompt:
Create ONE clean detailed GAME ASSET REFERENCE SHEET, NOT Blender or a3Dmodel. Plain light ivory studio background, soft even light, full uncropped separate objects, readable thickness, precise non-melting forms. FULL IDs and names outside silhouettes, dimensions marked PROPOSED. Each cell independent illustration scale. No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. Visible source facts: Sea-green stone observatory drum with arched lower facade and wave-edged balcony, giant gold/blue star clock, blue-bronze dome crossed by armillary-like gold rings, stairs and rocky tidal base. Hidden layout inference: A shore path/low bridge reaches a raised entrance deck, wraps along the wave balcony, then climbs to one sheltered viewing chamber or terrace. Keep clock facade facing arrival and retain open tidal views; nearby tide pools provide small discovery stops rather than a new city. Preserve this local design. Exactly12 isolated main components in a clean4-column grid. No missing/empty slots or repeated subjects counted twice. One clear front/three-quarter view with useful small rear/top/contact inset per cell. Truly flat backs for appliques, square join ends for repeat mouldings. Screens have repeated coherent holes, no tangled tendrils. Windows separate glass from surrounds, cornices/parapets and posts separate where named. Do not include large room/scenery fragments attached to a tiny detail. Title "B21-DETAIL-001 — Tidal Observatory — surface and detail kit". Footer "Proposed construction / source-compatible references / mesh joins and views unverified".

Purpose/gap: Need curved wall/clock reveal host, balcony/stair return, dome/ring supports and rock-to-deck contacts. Clock/wave/metal ring vocabulary already present; rotating or illuminated behavior is separate optional work. Salt grasses/seaweed, seabirds/crabs/tide-pool fauna proposed; tide levels not solved. Missing detached construction pieces and local interior-facing patterns.
